completion_promises.evidence: Created kv/kv-definitions.json at the correct path. File contains valid JSON with a top-level object containing a 'kv_buckets' array. Tests verify file existence, non-emptiness, directory location, JSON parseability, and structure (TestKvDefsFileExists class: 6 tests).

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] All 4 buckets defined with name, ttl, storage, history, max_value_size, description
completion_promises.evidence: All 4 buckets (agent-status, agent-registry, pipeline-state, jarvis-session) are defined with all required fields: name, ttl, storage, history, max_value_size, description, plus replicas for consistency with stream-definitions.json. Tests verify exact count (4), all expected names present, no duplicates, all required fields present, correct field types, and non-empty descriptions (TestKvBucketDefinitions class: 16 tests including parametrized).

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] TTL values use nats CLI duration format (e.g. "7d", "1h", "" for none)
completion_promises.evidence: TTL values use nats CLI duration format: empty string '' for no TTL (agent-status, agent-registry), '7d' for pipeline-state, '1h' for jarvis-session. Tests verify all TTL values are strings, empty or matching NATS duration pattern (digits + s/m/h/d), and each bucket has the correct expected TTL (TestKvBucketTtlFormat class: 10 tests including parametrized).

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] Storage types correctly assigned (file for persistent, memory for ephemeral)
completion_promises.evidence: Storage types are 'file' for agent-status, agent-registry, and pipeline-state (persistent); 'memory' for jarvis-session (ephemeral). Tests verify all storage values are in the valid set {file, memory}, and each bucket has the correct expected storage type (TestKvBucketStorageTypes class: 9 tests including parametrized).

History depths match spec exactly: agent-status=1, agent-registry=5, pipeline-state=3, jarvis-session=1. Tests verify all history values are positive integers, and each bucket has the correct expected history depth (TestKvBucketHistoryDepth class: 9 tests including parametrized).

completion_promises.criterion_text: [ ] JSON schema is consistent with stream-definitions.json style
completion_promises.evidence: JSON schema follows stream-definitions.json conventions: top-level object with array value, each entry is an object, bucket names use kebab-case, includes replicas field (always 1 for single-node), all entries have description field with non-empty string. Tests verify structural consistency, naming conventions, replicas field presence, and description field presence (TestKvDefsStyleConsistency class: 6 tests).
